correctness.rationale: For each Dyck word with exactly two missing peaks, four equal-letter adjacencies force exactly two mismatch intervals against the alternating word, so the VC upper bound four follows from the three-run obstruction. Six-size words exhibit all 16 traces at positions 2,4,7,8 and padding preserves them. An inductively exact finite-shattering recurrence, verified by two implementations and explicit depth-seven/eight trees, proves the n=3..11 table. A one-defect interval embedding gives the unbounded Ldim lower bound. The computations use only exact integers; no general online formula is claimed.

value.rationale: The fixed two-peak-deficit Narayana slice is a natural Catalan refinement, not an arbitrary restriction. An all-size VC classification and a growing online dimension exhibit a robust separation. The exact nine-point entropy obstruction is a natural threshold where concept count ceases to predict attainable decision-tree depth, providing a sharp benchmark for future peak-deficit layers.
